events.what: Dutour Sikirić and van Woerden complete Voronoi's algorithm in dimension 9, enumerating 2,237,251,040 perfect lattices and deriving γ9 = 2

judgement.doubts: The bullet asks for the Hermite constants in all dimensions other than 1–8 and 24; settling dimension 9 alone is a case. The 2.2-billion-lattice enumeration is not 'checkable' in the §3 sense (not a simple decisive check), so verification stays unreviewed; this does not affect the tier. The Feb 2026 revision is not shown to contain new mathematics, so the event is dated to the first version.

corrections.why: F1/F2: the record itself calls the result 'squarely a case of the stated problem'; it settles one dimension (9) of a bullet asking for all dimensions other than 1–8 and 24, so scope is case, which is partial regardless of verification.
